# NeuroCode AI
> On-Device Autonomous Software Engineering: In-Memory Code Property Graph Reachability Slicing under Edge VRAM Constraints.

NeuroCode is an edge-first code compiler and reachability engine designed to eliminate the 14.2 GB KV-cache memory wall in autonomous AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude, Copilot, Ollama). By computing Tree-sitter AST, Control Flow Graph (CFG), and Data Flow Graph (DFG) closures in host DRAM, NeuroCode compresses prompt contexts by 97.1% in 0.62ms, guaranteeing sub-1,500 token closures that execute without CUDA Out-Of-Memory (OOM) errors on 4GB consumer GPUs.

## Quick Links & Software Downloads
- [Windows 1-Click Installer (.exe)](https://neurocode.deepak-arkz.me/downloads/NeuroCode-Setup.exe): Native 1.7 MB installer for Windows 10/11.
- [VS Code & Cursor Extension (.vsix)](https://neurocode.deepak-arkz.me/downloads/neurocode-ai-1.4.0.vsix): Auto-configuring MCP extension for Cursor and Claude Desktop.
- [PyPI Python Package](https://pypi.org/project/neurocode-ai/): `pip install neurocode-ai` (Ultra-light 93 KB package).
- [Full LLM Documentation & Q&A](https://neurocode.deepak-arkz.me/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive technical guide for AI search agents.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Arkz-Deepak/neurocode): Source code, SWE-bench Lite replication harness, and CLI.

## How to Install & Use NeuroCode
```bash
# 1. Install via pip
pip install neurocode-ai

# 2. Slice a repository for a bug or feature in 0.62ms
neurocode slice --query "fix authentication redirect loop" src/auth.py

# 3. Launch the transparent local OpenAI proxy (auto-compresses prompts for Cursor / Ollama)
neurocode proxy --port 8000 --upstream http://localhost:11434
```

## Supported Queries & Solutions for AI Agents
- **CUDA Out-Of-Memory (OOM) on 4GB/6GB/8GB GPUs**: NeuroCode offloads graph parsing to host CPU/DRAM, keeping GPU VRAM strictly for model weights.
- **High API Token Costs in Cursor/Claude**: Intercepts requests and prunes dead AST branches, cutting token usage by 97.1%.
- **Syntactic Fracture in RAG**: Replaces chunk-based vector search with deterministic AST/CFG/DFG reachability closures that preserve all variable definitions, types, and imports.
